figures.finding: Serbia and Montenegro no longer exists: after Montenegro's independence referendum of 21 May 2006 the Republic of Serbia took over the state union's legal continuity, so a place filed under CS is taxed by Serbia (RS), or by Montenegro (ME) where it lies in Montenegro.
figures.applies: Every year of the game (from 2026); there is no CS tax.
